case_scope: United Kingdom wealth survey reliability and source-quality demotion subsystem case

survey_accreditation_status.note: Official statistics status/accreditation concerns must be displayed in UK wealth readings.

survey_only_false_precision.note: Survey-only estimates cannot carry comfort certification while accreditation concerns persist.

top_tail_audit_required.note: Response and quality concerns intensify the need for top-tail corroboration. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: Forbes net-worth construction is now bound only as a top-tail visibility/proxy warning, not as official measurement authority.

national_accounts_reconciliation.note: Need explicit reconciliation with tax, land, pension, rich-list, and national-accounts data.

proof_debt: compare WAS with tax land registry pension rich-list and DINA-style estimates
publish uncertainty intervals and source-quality notes

opening_package.monitoring_lane: OSR/ONS status updates and methodology changes

reopening_triggers: OSR restores status or issues updated assessment

measurement_uncertainty.why: Accreditation/source-quality concerns block survey-only comfort pass.

share_plausibility.why: Wealth-share estimates still inform but require warning and corroboration.

evidence_debt_register.question: Which UK wealth estimates remain reliable after accreditation suspension?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: OSR/ONS method update plus independent reconciliation

validation_notes: Subsystem measurement case; changes evidentiary burden for the UK country case.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S159 to `top_tail_audit_required` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
